help.body: 🤖 Fleet monitor Tap the buttons under this message. You don't need to type node names. /all overview, /nodes list, tap a machine for details. Lookup (commands still work) /go name one node /cpu /mem /disk /today /traffic /net /xray /uptime Add a name or all, e.g. /cpu all NIC occupancy (current throughput, no generated traffic) /net sg ~3s sample /net all Public speed test (download/upload via Cloudflare) /bw sg ~3s each way /bw sg 8 1–15s /bw all Coverage (typed, to avoid mis-taps) /add hk cap=2T reset=27 /cap hk 500G /off hk hide for now /on hk /kick hk remove; needs /add to return Caps: 500G / 1T / 2T / unlimited. The daily summary still sends automatically. Optional services (hidden unless configured) /svc hk xray 443,2053 /svc hk nginx 80,443 /svc hk xray off The node probes those TCP ports locally. The name is yours to choose. Tap 「中文」 or 「English」 to switch language.
hello.fleet: Fleet mode is on. Tap Overview first.
loading.speed_all: ⏳ Speed test running All machines will download+upload via Cloudflare, about 10+ seconds. This message will be replaced with results.
loading.speed_one: ⏳ Speed test running {name} Cloudflare download and upload, about 3 seconds each. This message will be replaced with results.
loading.nic_all: ⏳ Reading NICs Sampling each machine for about 3 seconds. No generated traffic.
loading.nic_one: ⏳ Reading NIC {name} Sampling current occupancy for about 3 seconds. No generated traffic.
job.timeout: ⏱ {name} {label} timed out No result after about 50 seconds. The node may be offline or busy. Tap again.
job.no_id: ❌ {name} could not submit {label} Hub returned no job id.
disabled: Disabled {name} (still listed, just excluded from totals)
unknown.command: Didn't catch that. Send /help or tap a button.
unknown.node: No such node. Open the node list first.
fleet.title: 🖥 Fleet overview
fleet.hint: Tap a machine for details, or tap Refresh.
node.no_heartbeat: 🖥 {name} No heartbeat yet. Confirm the agent is installed and can reach the hub.
node.unlimited_note: ✅ This node is billed as unlimited.
metric.net_hint: Tap NIC to sample 3 seconds on the card; tap Speed test to generate traffic.
nic.title: 🌐 {name} NIC now {seconds:.1f}s · {iface}
nic.hint: This is traffic currently on the NIC, not public bandwidth. Tap Speed test for that.
speed.title: 📡 {name} public speed test
speed.hint: Active download/upload via Cloudflare. This is public bandwidth, not idle NIC occupancy.
speed.up_fail: Download succeeded. Upload failed and is omitted: {reason}
add.done:
Added to coverage: {name} Cap {cap} · reset day {reset} On the target host: 
sudo ./install-host.sh --role agent \
  --hub {hub} \
  --name {name}
Use the same fleet token as the hub in /etc/traffic-monitor.env.
upload.too_little: upload timed out with almost no data sent
report.over: ⚠️ Over the plan cap; overage is typically egress-only.
report.reboot: ♻️ Host reboot detected. Daily totals continue from disk, not from zero.
report.ledger_fail: ⚠️ Traffic ledger read failed; this period may be incomplete.
report.projection: ⚠️ At the recent rate, period end may reach {projected}, over the cap. With {left} days left, stay under {budget}/day.
hub.bad_name: Name must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. hk-1
usage.svc: Usage: /svc hk xray 443,2053 /svc hk nginx 80,443 proc=nginx /svc hk xray off /svc hk off
svc.saved: Watching {svc} on {name} ports {ports}. Port status updates on the next heartbeat.
svc.not_configured: {name} has no service watch. Add one with /svc, e.g. /svc {name} xray 443.
svc.wait: ⏳ waiting for the node to probe
error.bad_svc: Service name must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. xray or nginx
error.bad_ports: cannot parse ports: {text}. Use 443,2053 in range 1–65535.
